definitions.explanation: the process of becoming old-fashioned, obsolete, or no longer useful due to advances in technology or changes in society

examples.japanese: {技術|ぎじゅつ}の{陳腐化|ちんぷか}が{速|はや}い。
{製品|せいひん}の{陳腐化|ちんぷか}に{対応|たいおう}する。
{計画的|けいかくてき}{陳腐化|ちんぷか}という{戦略|せんりゃく}がある。
examples.english: There is a strategy called planned obsolescence.

notes:
{陳腐化|ちんぷか} refers to things becoming outdated or obsolete.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {陳|ちん} (display, old)
- {腐|ふ} (rotten, stale)
- {化|か} (-ization)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {技術|ぎじゅつ}の{陳腐化|ちんぷか} (technological obsolescence)
- {製品|せいひん}の{陳腐化|ちんぷか} (product obsolescence)
- {計画的|けいかくてき}{陳腐化|ちんぷか} (planned obsolescence)
- {陳腐化|ちんぷか}{対策|たいさく} (obsolescence countermeasures)

USAGE:
- {陳腐化|ちんぷか}する (to become obsolete - suru verb)
- {陳腐化|ちんぷか}が{進|すす}む (obsolescence advances)

BUSINESS CONCEPT:
{計画的|けいかくてき}{陳腐化|ちんぷか} (planned obsolescence) refers to deliberately designing products to become outdated, encouraging consumers to buy new versions.

RELATED TERMS:
- {陳腐|ちんぷ} (stale, hackneyed)
- {時代遅|じだいおく}れ (out of date)
- {旧式|きゅうしき} (old-fashioned)
